intervention: system prompt arm (prompts/<arm>.txt), no weight or activation changes
effect_metric: ANIMA-2.2 dev split (56 questions, all languages), overall_mean, 3 epochs, temp 1.0, max 2048 tokens, thinking enabled; grader openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite; baseline arm 'none' overall_mean 0.631
intrusion_metric: fraction of 16 neutral-question free generations (temp 0.9, 300 max tokens, thinking disabled via /no_think, 3 samples/question, mean fraction) matching FLAG_RE over final text only
